# Source: "The Arts" Ewer and Basin

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** "The Arts" Ewer and Basin
- **Artist / culture:** Jules-Paul Brateau French, 1844-1923 Paris, France
- **Date:** 1887/89
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** ewer (vessel)
- **Department:** Applied Arts of Europe
- **AIC artwork ID:** 618
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/618
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/f6093dc6-a3c2-f783-f921-a9bb8449c6c6/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Art Deco

## Extracted source palette

`#F8F8F8, #787868, #989888, #585848, #A8A8A8, #D8D8D8, #C8C8B8, #483838`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#FCFCFC`
- `surface`: `#FEFEFE`
- `on_surface`: `#0F0F11`
- `primary`: `#483838`
- `on_primary`: `#F8F8F6`
- `secondary`: `#F8F8F8`
- `surface_variant`: `#E0E0E0`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#0F0F11`
- `outline`: `#BABABA`
- `error`: `#483838`
- `on_error`: `#F8F8F6`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `20dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `18.66:1`, surface `18.99:1`
- Variant contrast: `14.5:1`
- Control contrast: `10.4:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
